newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK/CYPRUS SLASHES LOAN, DEPO RATES JAN 20.
newsitem.headline: BANK/CYPRUS SLASHES LOAN, DEPO RATES JAN 20.

text.p: The Bank of Cyprus, Athens slashed its base drachma lending rates 100 basis points to 16.25 percent effective January 20, it said in a statement.

The interest rate on repair loans was reduced to 19 percent from 20.75 percent, the mortgage rate to 15 percent from 15.75 percent and the consumer loan rate to 20.50 percent from 22.75 percent, it said.
The interest rate on sight accounts was also cut and will offer rates up to 8.0 percent from 9.5 percent, the Cyplus account will offer lower rates up to 11.25 percent from 12 percent, it said.
The savings rate was reduced to 10.50 percent from 11 percent and the current Cyover was cut to 7.0 percent from 8.5 percent, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
